articles.heading: Icyo iri tegeko rigamije Iri tegeko rigenga uburyo bwo guteza imbere no kugenzura ubucuruzi bw’umutungo
articles.text:
koranabuhanga mu Rwanda, hagamijwe –
(a) gukumira no kugabanya ingorane
zijyanye n’iyezandonke, gutera
inkunga iterabwoba no gutera inkunga
ikwirakwiza ry’intwaro za kirimbuzi
byabaho hakoreshejwe umutungo
koranabuhanga;
(b) gushyigikira ubwangamugayo ku
isoko, imyitwarire iboneye no gukorera
mu mucyo mu rwego rw’umutungo
koranabuhanga;
(c) kurengera umuguzi n’umushoramari
mu bijyanye n’ubucuruzi
bw’umutungo koranabuhanga;
(d) kubungabunga ukutajegajega
k’urwego rw’imari no gukumira
ingorane zishobora kurubangamira
kubera urusobekerane ruri hagati
y’uruhererekane rw’ibikorwa
by’umutungo koranabuhanga
n’urwego rw’imari muri rusange
n’ibikorwa by’ubukungu bya buri
munsi;
(e) no guteza imbere ibikorwa byo
guhanga ibishya mu rwego
rw’ubucuruzi bw’umutungo
koranabuhanga.

articles.heading: Isobanura Muri iri tegeko
articles.text:
(a) «Akanama k’Ubujurire Kigenga »
bivuga Akanama k’Ubujurire
gashinzwe kwakira ubujurire ku
byemezo byafashwe n’Urwego
Ngenzuramikorere ku bibazo bijyanye
n’isoko ry’imari n’imigabane;
(b) « amabwiriza » bivuga inyandiko
ishyirwaho n’Urwego
Ngenzuramikorere igamije gusobanura
kurushaho ibigomba kubahirizwa mu
rwego rwo gushyira mu bikorwa
ibiteganywa muri iri tegeko;
(c) «amabwiriza yihariye» bivuga
inyandiko ishyirwaho n’Urwego
Ngenzuramikorere cyangwa Banki
Nkuru igaragaza ibisabwa gukorwa
cyangwa kudakorwa igenewe umuntu
ku giti cye cyangwa ikigo gifite
ubuzimagatozi;
(d) « Banki Nkuru » bivuga Banki Nkuru
y’u Rwanda;
(e) « guhagarika umutungo
koranabuhanga » bivuga igikorwa
cy’utanga serivisi z’umutungo
koranabuhanga cyangwa cy’ushyira ku
isoko umutungo koranabuhanga,
abitegetswe n’urwego rubifitiye
ububasha, hagamijwe –
(i) kugabanya cyangwa
guhagarika ibindi bikorwa
by’ubucuruzi cyangwa
gusubirana agaciro
k’umutungo koranabuhanga;
(ii) gushyira aderesi y’umutungo
koranabuhanga ku rutonde
rw’abatemerewe gukora
ibikorwa byo guhererekanya
umutungo koranabuhanga;
(iii) cyangwa kugabanya agaciro
kawo;
(f) « guhamagarira bwa mbere
rubanda kugura umutungo
koranabuhanga » bivuga
guhamagarira ku nshuro ya mbere
rubanda cyangwa bamwe muri
rubanda, kugura umutungo
koranabuhanga bakoresheje ifaranga
risanzwe cyangwa undi mutungo
koranabuhanga;
(g) « gusimbuza umutungo ufatika
tokeni » bivuga uburyo bukoresha
ikoranabuhanga rishya nk’ububiko
koranabuhanga bw’uruhererekane
rw’ibikorwa butuma umutungo ufatika
cyangwa umutungo w’imari
uhagararirwa na tokeni
koranabuhanga;
(h) « ibikorwa bijyanye n’umutungo
koranabuhanga » bivuga ibikorwa
bifitanye isano no gushyira ku isoko,
gucuruza, guhanahana, guhererekanya,
kubika no gucunga umutungo
koranabuhanga n’ibindi bikorwa byose
bigenwa n’Urwego Ngenzuramikorere
hatarimo amasoko y’umutungo
koranabuhanga adasaba abahuza
n’ibikorwa bifite amabwiriza yerekeye
ikoranabuhanga yigenga adafite
urwego ruyagenzura;
(i) « ibikorwaremezo byifashishwa mu
guhanga umutungo
koranabuhanga » bivuga ahantu,
porogaramu ya mudasobwa cyangwa
ibikoresho by’ikoranabuhanga rya
mudasobwa bifatika cyangwa ibindi
bisa na byo, bikoreshwa mu gukora
cyangwa gushyigikira ibikorwa byo
guhanga umutungo koranabuhanga
nk’ubucuruzi, mu rwego rwo kwemeza
ibikorwa by’ubucuruzi byahanzwe no
kubishyira ku rubuga rw’amakuru
rusange hagamijwe kubona inyungu;
(j) « ifaranga koranabuhanga
ridahindagurika » bivuga umutungo
koranabuhanga ufite agaciro
gashingiye ku mutungo wihariye
uzigamwe cyangwa ku ruhurirane
rw’imitungo izigamwe nk’ifaranga
risanzwe, ibicuruzwa by’ibanze
cyangwa irindi faranga koranabuhanga
ryemewe mu Gihugu hagamijwe ko
rigumana agaciro kadahindagurika;
(k) « ifaranga koranabuhanga
ridahindagurika rishingiye kuri
aligoritime » bivuga ifaranga
koranabuhanga rishobora
kudahindagurika mu gaciro
hifashishijwe amabwiriza yerekeye
ikoranabuhanga ateganya kongera
cyangwa kugabanya itangwa ry’iryo
faranga koranabuhanga bitewe
n’impinduka zabaye ku busabe
bwaryo;
(l) « ifaranga risanzwe » bivuga ifaranga
riri mu buryo bw’inoti, ubw’ibiceri
cyangwa ubundi buryo bw’amafaranga
bwemejwe n’urwego rw’igihugu
rukora ifaranga;
(m)« igeragezwa ry’ibishya » bivuga
uburyo bukurikiza amategeko bwo
kugerageza ibicuruzwa cyangwa
serivisi bishya ku rugero ruto mu gihe
cyagenwe kandi bukagenzurwa
n’urwego bireba;
(n) « igitabo cy’ibaruramari
gisangiwe » bivuga ububiko
bw’amakuru bushyirwamo inyandiko
z’ibikorwa by’ubucuruzi, busangirwa
kandi buhuzwa hagati ya mudasobwa
zitandukanye ziri ku muyoboro
w’ikoranabuhanga ry’igitabo
cy’ibaruramari gisangiwe,
hakoreshejwe uburyo
bw’ubwumvikane busesuye bw’abari
ku muyoboro bose ku birebana
n’agaciro n’ukuri kw’ibikorwa;
(o) «ikigo gifite ubuzimagatozi» bivuga
isosiyete y’ubucuruzi, koperative
cyangwa urwego rutari umuntu ku giti
cye bihabwa uburenganzira
n’inshingano imbere y’amategeko;
(p) « ikoranabuhanga ry’igitabo
cy’ibaruramari gisangiwe » bivuga
ikoranabuhanga rituma igitabo
cy’ibaruramari gisangiwe gishobora
gukora no gukoreshwa;
(q) « imirongo ngenderwaho » bivuga
inyandiko ishyirwaho n’Urwego
Ngenzuramikorere itanga icyerekezo
ku bikorwa biri mu nshingano cyangwa
mu bubasha byarwo;
(r) « kumenyekanisha » bivuga igikorwa
cyo kwamamaza, guhamagarira,
gushishikariza, kureshya, gutanga
cyangwa guteza imbere mu bijyanye na
serivisi cyangwa igicuruzwa;
(s)« serivisi yo kuvanga umutungo
koranabuhanga » bivuga tekiniki
cyangwa serivisi yo guhisha amakuru,
ivanga imitungo koranabuhanga
itandukanye ifite inkomoko ishobora
kumenyekana, igahisha inkomoko
y’amafaranga ashorwa mu mutungo
koranabuhanga wihariye;
(t) « sisitemu ifungiranye » bivuga
ibikorwa cyangwa uburyo
bw’imikorere, aho umutungo
koranabuhanga uhererekanywa
ahantu ntarengwa kandi nta buryo
ushobora guhindurwamo ifaranga
risanzwe cyangwa ngo woherezwe
hanze y’iyo sisitemu;
(u) « ububiko koranabuhanga
bw’uruhererekane rw’ibikorwa »
bivuga igitabo koranabuhanga
cy’ibaruramari cyangwa ububiko
bw’amakuru y’ibikorwa byerekeye
umutungo koranabuhanga byandikwa
bikurikiranye hakurikijwe igihe
byabereye kandi bishobora
kugenzurwa;
(v) « ubucuruzi bw’umutungo
koranabuhanga » bivuga ubucuruzi
bwose bufitanye isano n’ibikorwa
bijyanye n’umutungo koranabuhanga;
(w)« umugenerwabikorwa » bivuga
umuntu ku giti cye, ikigo cyangwa
urundi rwego bifite
ubuzimagatozi cyangwa ubwumvikane
bushingiye ku masezerano bigira
uburenganzira ku mutungo
koranabuhanga igikorwa cyo
guhererekanya kirangiye;
(x) « umukiriya » bivuga umuntu ku giti
cye, ikigo gifite ubuzimagatozi
cyangwa ubwumvikane bushingiye ku
masezerano bihabwa serivisi
z’umutungo koranabuhanga n’utanga
serivisi z’umutungo koranabuhanga;
(y) « umutungo koranabuhanga uhisha
mu buryo bukomeye umwirondoro
w’uwukoresha » bivuga umutungo
koranabuhanga ufite uburyo bwo
kurinda amakuru ku mibereho bwite
y’abantu hagamijwe guhisha amakuru
ku bikorwa by’ihererekanya
ry’imitungo, umwirondoro w’ukora
ibyo bikorwa cyangwa uburyo
imitungo ihererekanywa;
(z) « umutungo ufatika » bivuga
umutungo uriho mu buryo bufatika
cyangwa mu rwego rusanzwe
rw’imari, ariko ushobora
guhagararirwa, gusimbuzwa tokeni
cyangwa gucuruzwa mu buryo
bw’ikoranabuhanga ku muyoboro
w’ububiko koranabuhanga
bw’uruhererekane rw’ibikorwa
by’ubucuruzi;
(aa) « umutungo uzigamwe » bivuga
umutungo shingiro ubikwa
n’umubitsi w’umutungo mu izina
ry’ushyira ku isoko ifaranga
koranabuhanga ridahindagurika
kugira ngo rigumane agaciro
k’umutungo rishingiyeho;
(bb) « Urwego Ngenzuramikorere »
bivuga Urwego rw’u Rwanda
rushinzwe Isoko ry’Imari
n’Imigabane;
(cc) « ushyira ku isoko » bivuga ikigo
gifite ubuzimagatozi cyemerewe
guhamagarira rubanda cyangwa
bamwe muri rubanda kugura
umutungo koranabuhanga
hakurikijwe iri tegeko;
(dd) « utanga serivisi z’umutungo
koranabuhanga » bivuga ikigo
gifite ubuzimagatozi cyanditswe mu
Rwanda kandi gihabwa uruhushya
rwo gutanga serivisi z’umutungo
koranabuhanga nk’ubucuruzi
bukorerwa mu Rwanda cyangwa
bukomoka mu Rwanda;
(ee) « uwohereza » bivuga, mu bijyanye
no guhererekanya umutungo
koranabuhanga, umuntu ku giti cye
cyangwa ikigo gifite ubuzimagatozi
bisaba utanga serivisi z’umutungo
koranabuhanga kuwuhererekanya.

articles.heading: Ibirebwa n’iri tegeko (1) Iri tegeko rireba utanga serivisi z’umutungo koranabuhanga n’ushyira ku
articles.text:
isoko bakorera mu Rwanda.
(2) Iri tegeko ntirireba ibi bikurikira:
(a) gutanga serivisi z’ibikoresho
n’ubufasha bwa tekiniki;
(b) gukora ibikoresho no gutanga serivisi
z’ubuhanga mu gukora porogaramu
z’ikoranabuhanga;
(c) serivisi zihabwa ukora ibikoresho
bibikwamo kode kandi bifasha
gucunga ifaranga koranabuhanga.

articles.heading: Umutungo koranabuhanga n’ibiwugize (1) Umutungo koranabuhanga ni uburyo koranabuhanga bwo guhagararira agaciro
articles.text:
gashobora gucuruzwa cyangwa
guhererekanywa mu buryo
koranabuhanga kandi gashobora
gukoreshwa mu kwishyura cyangwa mu
gushora imari.
(2) Umutungo koranabuhanga urimo uburyo
koranabuhanga bwo kugaragaza agaciro –
(a) kagamije guhagararira umutungo
ufatika mu bubiko koranabuhanga
bw’uruhererekane rw’ibikorwa
cyangwa mu rindi koranabuhanga,
ryaba ririndirwa umutekano mu buryo
bwo guhisha amakuru cyangwa mu
bundi buryo kandi gashobora gutanga
uburenganzira, inshingano, ibyo
kwishyuza cyangwa inyungu bijyanye
n’uwo mutungo ufatika;
(b) kandi gashingiye ku mutungo
uzigamiwe nk’ingwate cyangwa ku
mutungo wateganyirijwe
kubungabunga agaciro
kadahindagurika.
(3) Umutungo koranabuhanga nturimo –
(a) uburyo koranabuhanga bwo
guhagararira amafaranga asanzwe;
(b) uburyo bwo kwishyurana bugenzurwa
na Banki Nkuru;
(c) inyandiko z’agaciro cyangwa
inyandiko z’isoko ry’imari
n’imigabane zigengwa n’amategeko
y’isoko ry’imari n’imigabane;
(d) amafaranga koranabuhanga acungwa
na Banki Nkuru cyangwa banki nkuru
y’igihugu cy’amahanga;
(e) uburyo koranabuhanga bwo
guhagararira agaciro cyangwa
uburenganzira bikorera muri sisitemu
ifungiranye;
(f) umutungo koranabuhanga ushyirwaho
kandi ugahangwa binyuze mu bubiko
koranabuhanga bw’uruhererekane
rw’ibikorwa by’ubucuruzi cyangwa
irindi koranabuhanga kugira ngo
ukoreshwe ku mpamvu bwite cyangwa
ku mpamvu iyo ari yo yose yagenwe
n’uwawuhanze itari iy’ubucuruzi,
kwishyurana cyangwa ishoramari;
(g) umutungo koranabuhanga wihariye
kandi udashobora gusimburwa;
(h) umutungo koranabuhanga uhisha mu
buryo bukomeye imyirondoro
y’uwukoresha n’ibikorwa bifitanye
isano na wo;
(i) amafaranga koranabuhanga
adahindagurika ashingiye kuri
aligoritime;
(j) n’undi mutungo w’imari ugengwa
n’andi mategeko mu Rwanda.
UMUTWE WA II: URWEGO
NGENZURAMIKORERE

articles.heading: Urwego Ngenzuramikorere Urwego Ngenzuramikorere ni rwo rugenzura ibyerekeye ubucuruzi bw’umutungo
articles.text: koranabuhanga.

articles.heading: Inshingano z’Urwego Ngenzuramikorere Mu bijyanye n’ubucuruzi bw’umutungo koranabuhanga, Urwego Ngenzuramikorere
articles.text:
rufite inshingano zikurikira:
(a) kwemeza no kugenzura ishyirwa ku
isoko ry’umutungo koranabuhanga,
kwemera ko umutungo koranabuhanga
ucuruzwa no gusimbuza umutungo
ufatika tokeni;
(b) kumenya utanga serivisi z’umutungo
koranabuhanga utubahiriza iri tegeko;
(c) kurengera umushoramari n’umuguzi
no kubungabunga ubwangamugayo ku
isoko n’ukutajegajega k’urwego
rw’imari mu bijyane n’umutungo
koranabuhanga;
(d) guteza imbere ibishya no kuzamura
urwego rw’umutungo koranabuhanga
hagabanywa ingorane;
(e) gukurikirana ko utanga serivisi
z’umutungo koranabuhanga
yubahiriza ibisabwa mu kurwanya
iyezandonke, gutera inkunga
iterabwoba no gutera inkunga
ikwirakwiza ry’intwaro za kirimbuzi;
(f) kumenya no gusesengura ingorane
zijyanye n’ibikorwa by’iyezandonke,
ibyo gutera inkunga iterabwoba n’ibyo
gutera inkunga ikwirakwiza ry’intwaro
za kirimbuzi zishobora gukomoka ku
bikorwa by’umutungo koranabuhanga
no mu mikorere y’abatanga serivisi
z’umutungo koranabuhanga no
gukoresha uburyo bushingiye ku
ngorane mu rwego rwo kuzigabanya;
(g) gufatanya n’inzego z’imbere mu
Gihugu n’izo ku rwego
mpuzamahanga ku birebana
n’amabwiriza agenga umutungo
koranabuhanga ku rwego
mpuzamahanga;
(h) kugira inama Leta ku bibazo byose
bijyanye n’ubucuruzi bw’umutungo
koranabuhanga;
(i) gukorana no gufatanya n’inzego
zibifitiye ububasha zo mu Gihugu
n’inzego ngenzuramikorere zo mu
mahanga bihuje inshingano;
(j) gufata ingamba zifasha kumenya
abantu ku giti cyabo cyangwa ibigo
bifite ubuzimagatozi bikora ubucuruzi
bw’umutungo koranabuhanga
bitabyemerewe cyangwa bidafite
uruhushya rusabwa no kubifatira
ibihano bikwiye;
(k) gukora nk’urwego ruhuza mu
guhanahana amakuru yerekeye
ubucuruzi bw’umutungo
koranabuhanga;
(l) kuzuza izindi nshingano zifasha mu
kuzuza uko bikwiye ibiteganywa n’iri
tegeko.

articles.heading: Ububasha bw’Urwego Ngenzuramikorere Mu bucuruzi bw’umutungo koranabuhanga, Urwego Ngenzuramikorere rufite ububasha
articles.text:
bukurikira:
(a) gutanga, guhagarika by’agateganyo,
guhagarika burundu cyangwa
guhindura uruhushya rw’utanga
serivisi z’umutungo koranabuhanga;
(b) gushyiraho amabwiriza, amabwiriza
yihariye n’imirongo ngenderwaho;
(c) gushyiraho ingamba za ngombwa zo
gushyira mu bikorwa iri tegeko;
(d) gushyiraho ibipimo ngenderwaho
byerekeranye no gukora ubucuruzi
bw’umutungo koranabuhanga;
(e) gushyira mu byiciro no kugena
ubwoko bw’umutungo koranabuhanga,
serivisi z’umutungo koranabuhanga
n’ibyiciro by’abatanga serivisi
z’umutungo koranabuhanga ;
(f) guhagarika by’agateganyo cyangwa
kubuza bumwe mu bwoko
bw’umutungo koranabuhanga iyo
bibaye ngombwa;
(g) gufata, mu bushishozi bwarwo,
ingamba zose rubona ko ari ngombwa
zijyanye cyangwa mu buryo bukwiye
zifitanye isano no kuzuza inshingano
zarwo hakurikijwe ibiteganywa n’iri
tegeko.

articles.heading: Imikoranire y’Urwego Ngenzuramikorere na Banki Nkuru (1) Mu rwego rw’ubucuruzi bw’umutungo koranabuhanga, Urwego
articles.text:
Ngenzuramikorere na Banki Nkuru
bishyiraho –
(a) uburyo bwo kujya inama no gufatanya
hagamijwe guhuza politiki
n’amabwiriza igihe bibaye ngombwa,
mu rwego rwo kubungabunga
ukutajegajega k’urwego rw’imari no
gutuma urwego rw’imari rurangwa
n’ubwangamugayo;
(b) n’uburyo buhuje bwo gusangira
amakuru, gusesengura ingorane
zishobora kubaho no gushyiraho
ingamba zituma amategeko
yubahirizwa, hagamijwe kugenzura
neza abatanga serivisi z’umutungo
koranabuhanga.
(2) Ku bufatanye n’Urwego
Ngenzuramikorere, Banki Nkuru –
(a) igenzura inkurikizi ubucuruzi
bw’umutungo koranabuhanga bugira
ku ifaranga no ku kutajegajega
k’urwego rw’imari;
(b) ikurikirana ingaruka ubucuruzi
bw’umutungo koranabuhanga bugira
ku buryo bwo kwishyurana mu
Gihugu;
(c) ikora ku buryo ibikorwa by’ubucuruzi
byerekeye umutungo koranabuhanga
bitabangamira urwego rw’imari;
(d) ikanashyiraho amabwiriza yihariye ku
bijyanye n’urwego rw’umutungo
koranabuhanga biri mu nshingano
zayo.

articles.heading: Guhanahana amakuru (1) Urwego Ngenzuramikorere rugirana amasezerano y’imikoranire n’ibigo ngenzuramikorere byo mu Gihugu
articles.text:
cyangwa ibyo mu mahanga n’inzego
zibifitiye ububasha ku bijyanye no
guhanahana amakuru no gushyira mu
bikorwa inshingano ziteganywa n’iri
tegeko.
(2) Mu gushyira mu bikorwa ibiteganywa mu
gika cya (1), Urwego Ngenzuramikorere –
(a) rureba ko uburyo bw’imikoranire
buteganya imikorere inoze mu
guhanahana amakuru;
(b) kandi rukanagenzura ko amakuru
y’ibanga arinzwe hakurikijwe
amategeko abigenga.
UMUTWE WA III: URUHUSHYA RWO
GUTANGA SERIVISI Z’UMUTUNGO
KORANABUHANGA

articles.heading: Gusaba uruhushya rwo gutanga serivisi z’umutungo koranabuhanga no kuruhabwa (1) Ikigo gifite ubuzimagatozi cyifuza
articles.text:
gutanga serivisi z’umutungo
koranabuhanga gishyikiriza ubusabe
Urwego Ngenzuramikorere hakurikijwe
uburyo bugenwa n’amabwiriza.
(2) Urwego Ngenzuramikorere ruha
uruhushya uwarusabye iyo rusanze –
(a)ari ikigo gifite ubuzimagatozi kandi
ishingwa ryacyo rikaba ryarakozwe
hakurikijwe amategeko y’u Rwanda
cyangwa hakurikijwe amategeko yo
mu mahanga, cyariyandikishije kandi
gikorera mu Rwanda;
(b)afite imiterere y’umutungo igaragara
neza kandi iboneye akanatanga
amakuru yuzuye kuri ba
nyir’umutungo nyabo;
(c)afite uburyo bunoze bw’imiyoborere,
harimo Inama y’Ubutegetsi ifite
imikorere inoze n’ubuyobozi bukuru
bushinzwe ibikorwa bya buri munsi
bifite ubushobozi n’ubwangamugayo;
(d)agaragaza neza ibikorwa by’ubucuruzi
azakora na gahunda y’ibikorwa
ishoboka ijyanye n’imiterere, ingano
n’urusobe bya serivisi z’umutungo
koranabuhanga ateganya gutanga;
(e)afite ubushobozi buhagije mu
by’imari, mu bya tekiniki no mu
mikorere;
(f)afite imari shingiro itagibwa munsi
n’igenwa mu mabwiriza hashingiwe
ku miterere n’ingano bya serivisi
z’umutungo koranabuhanga zitangwa;
(g)kandi afite uburyo bunoze bwo
kurwanya ibikorwa by’iyezandonke,
ibyo gutera inkunga iterabwoba n’ibyo
gutera inkunga ikwirakwiza ry’intwaro
za kirimbuzi, bujyanye n’amategeko
n’amahame mpuzamahanga abigenga.
(3) Amabwiriza agena ibindi
bishingirwaho, ibipimo ngenderwaho
n’uburyo bikurikizwa mu gusaba no
gutanga uruhushya ku batanga serivisi
z’umutungo koranabuhanga.

articles.heading: Guhagarika uruhushya by’agateganyo cyangwa kurwambura burundu uwaruhawe (1) Urwego Ngenzuramikorere rushobora
articles.text:
guhagarika uruhushya by’agateganyo ku
kigo gifite ubuzimagatozi cyaruhawe
iyo rusanze –
(a) ari ngombwa mu rwego rwo
kurengera umushoramari cyangwa
umuguzi, kwita ku migenzereze
iboneye ku isoko cyangwa
kubungabunga ukutajegajega
k’urwego rw’imari;
(b) kitubahiriza ibyo gisabwa cyangwa
ibigomba gukurikizwa bisabwa mu
rwego rw’igenzuramikorere;
(c) cyararuhaye amakuru atari ukuri,
ayobya cyangwa atuzuye;
(d) kitarengera inyungu z’umukiriya
cyangwa kidakemura ibibazo
yakigaragarije;
(e) gishobora guteza ingorane
cyangwa hari impamvu zumvikana
zituma gikekwaho ko cyateza
ingorane ku mukiriya, ku
migenzereze iboneye ku isoko
cyangwa ku kutajegajega k’urwego
rw’imari ;
(f) kitaratangiye ibikorwa mu gihe
kigenwa n’amabwiriza cyangwa
cyarahagaritse gutanga serivisi
cyaherewe uruhushya kitabanje
kubyemererwa.
(2) Urwego Ngenzuramikorere rushobora
kwambura burundu uruhushya ikigo
gifite ubuzimagatozi cyaruhawe, iyo
rusanze –
(a) gikora ubucuruzi cyangwa
cyamamaza serivisi mu buryo burimo
uburiganya cyangwa buyobya;
(b) cyarahawe uruhushya hakoreshejwe
uburiganya, amakuru atari ukuri
cyangwa guhisha amakuru y’ingenzi;
(c) kidashoboye kwishyura imyenda
cyangwa kitagishoboye kuzuza
inshingano mu rwego rw’imari;
(d) kitubahiriza ku buryo bukomeye
cyangwa inshuro nyinshi iri tegeko
cyangwa amabwiriza ariho;
(e) gikora cyangwa gitera inkunga
ibikorwa biganisha ku cyaha
cy’iyezandonke, icyo gutera inkunga
iterabwoba cyangwa icyo gutera
inkunga ikwirakwiza ry’intwaro za
kirimbuzi;
(f) habaye iseswa ry’ibikorwa cyangwa
habaye indi mpamvu ituma kitongera
kugaragara ku isoko;
(g) hari icyemezo ndakuka cy’urukiko
gitegeka iyegeranya n’igabagabanya
ry’umutungo cyangwa iseswa
ry’ibikorwa.
(3) Urwego Ngenzuramikorere, mbere yo
guhagarika uruhushya by’agateganyo
cyangwa kurwambura burundu utanga
serivisi z’umutungo koranabuhanga
rumuha integuza n’umwanya wo
kwisobanura, keretse mu gihe ari
ngombwa gufata icyemezo cyihuse
hagamijwe gukumira icyabangamira
ku buryo bukomeye umushoramari,
umuguzi, isoko cyangwa urwego
rw’imari.
(4) Urwego Ngenzuramikorere, nyuma yo
guhagarika uruhushya by’agateganyo,
rushobora kugena ibindi bigomba
kubahirizwa n’uwari waruhawe kugira
ngo akosore ibyo atubahirije.
(5) Amabwiriza ashobora kugena ku buryo
burambuye ibishingirwaho
n’ibikurikizwa mu guhagarika
uruhushya by’agateganyo cyangwa
kurwambura burundu uwaruhawe.

articles.heading: Uburenganzira bwo kujurira Iyo utanga serivisi z’umutungo koranabuhanga atanyuzwe n’icyemezo
articles.text:
cyafashwe n’Urwego Ngenzuramikorere ku
ihagarikwa ry’uruhushya by’agateganyo
cyangwa ku kwamburwa uruhushya burundu,
ashobora kujuririra Akanama k’Ubujurire
Kigenga.

articles.heading: Igeragezwa ry’ibishya (1) Igeragezwa ry’ibishya rishyirwaho hagamijwe gukora igerageza ry’imikorere mishya mu bucuruzi
articles.text:
ifitanye isano n’umutungo
koranabuhanga utavugwa muri iri
tegeko.
(2) Umuntu ushaka gukora igerageza
ry’imikorere mu bucuruzi ifitanye isano
n’umutungo koranabuhanga arikora
abinyujije mu igeragezwa ry’ibishya.
(c) kuvunja ifaranga risanzwe mu
mutungo koranabuhanga no kuvunja
umutungo koranabuhanga mu ifaranga
risanzwe;
(d) kuvunja hagati y’ubwoko bumwe
cyangwa bwinshi bw’umutungo
koranabuhanga;
(e) gutanga serivisi z’ihererekanya
ry’umutungo koranabuhanga mu izina
ry’umukiriya;
(f) kwakira no gufata ibyemezo mu
kugura no kugurisha umutungo
koranabuhanga mu izina ry’umukiriya;
(g) gushyira mu bikorwa ibyemezo
bijyanye n’umutungo koranabuhanga
mu izina ry’umukiriya;
(h) kugira uruhare mu kugura no
kugurisha umutungo koranabuhanga;
(i) kubika no gucunga umutungo
koranabuhanga mu izina ry’umukiriya;
(j) gutanga serivisi zo kubika umutungo
koranabuhanga kugeza igihe ibisabwa
byujujwe kugira ngo utangwe;
(k) gutanga inama ku bijyanye
n’ishoramari ku mutungo
koranabuhanga;
(l) gucunga ishoramari ry’umutungo
koranabuhanga.
(2) Amabwiriza ashobora kugena izindi
serivisi z’umutungo koranabuhanga.

articles.heading: Serivisi z’umutungo koranabuhanga
Ibibujijwe mu bucuruzi bw’umutungo koranabuhanga (1) Umuntu ku giti cye ntiyemerewe gukorera cyangwa kwitwa ko akorera
articles.text:
ubucuruzi bw’umutungo
koranabuhanga mu Rwanda.
(2) Umutungo koranabuhanga ntufatwa
nk’ifaranga ryemewe mu Rwanda.
(3) Umutungo koranabuhanga ntukoreshwa
mu buryo butaziguye nk’uburyo bwo
kwishyura ibicuruzwa, serivisi, imyenda
cyangwa indi nshingano yo mu rwego
rw’imari, keretse byemejwe na Banki
Nkuru.
(4) Uretse mu gihe byemejwe n’Urwego
Ngenzuramikorere ku bufatanye
n’inzego bireba, ikigo gifite
ubuzimagatozi nticyemerewe gukora –
(a) ibikorwaremezo byifashishwa mu
guhanga umutungo koranabuhanga;
(b) imashini itanga amafaranga
koranabuhanga cyangwa umutungo
koranabuhanga;
(c) na serivisi yo kuvanga no guhisha
inkomoko y’umutungo koranabuhanga.
(5) Ikigo gifite ubuzimagatozi
nticyemerewe gukora ibikorwa byo
kumenyekanisha birebana n’umutungo
koranabuhanga cyangwa ibikorwa
bijyanye na wo, keretse iyo ari igitanga
serivisi z’umutungo koranabuhanga
gifite uruhushya cyangwa ushyira ku
isoko ubyemerewe.
UMUTWE WA V: GUSHYIRA KU ISOKO
UMUTUNGO KORANABUHANGA

articles.heading: Gusimbuza umutungo ufatika tokeni (1) Ikigo gifite ubuzimagatozi gishaka gushyira ku isoko tokeni ihagarariye
articles.text:
umutungo ufatika mu Rwanda cyangwa
gishaka ko iyo tokeni yemererwa
gucuruzwa ku rubuga rw’ubucuruzi
rukoreshwa n’utanga serivisi z’umutungo
koranabuhanga wemewe mu Rwanda,
kibanza kwemererwa n’Urwego
Ngenzuramikorere.
(2) Umugenagaciro w’umutungo wemewe
agena agaciro gahagarariwe na tokeni kandi
iryo genagaciro akarikora mu mucyo, mu
buryo ngarukagihe kandi agahora arihuza
n’igihe.
(3) Igenagaciro ryemeza ko tokeni yishingiwe
n’umutungo unganya agaciro na yo 100%
kandi uwo mutungo ubikwa
utandukanyijwe n’indi mitungo ku buryo
udakorwaho kandi ntushobora kugurizwa
abandi hagamijwe izindi nyungu;
(4) Umutungo ufatika tokeni ishingiyeho
ubikwa neza n’umubitsi wabigize umwuga
ubifitiye uruhushya kandi ugenzurwa mu
buryo buhoraho bugenwa n’amabwiriza.
(5) Ushyira ku isoko atanga inyandiko
zishobora kugenzurwa zigaragaza ko ari we
nyir’umutungo.
(6)Amabwiriza ashobora kugena ibindi
bisabwa mu gushyira ku isoko no gucuruza
tokeni ihagarariye umutungo ufatika.

articles.heading: Umutungo ufatika utemerewe gusimbuzwa tokeni (1) Mu mitungo ifatika itemerewe gusimbuzwa tokeni harimo–
articles.text:
(a) umutungo rusange wa Leta;
(b) ibikorwaremezo rusange;
(c) amakuru yerekeye umuntu ku giti cye;
(d) ibihangano by’ubugeni;
(e) cyangwa undi mutungo cyangwa
ibyiciro by’umutungo bidashobora
guhabwa agaciro mu buryo bunyuze
mu mucyo, kurengerwa hashingiwe ku
mategeko cyangwa kwemezwa ko
byabonetse mu buryo bwiza.
(2) Urwego Ngenzuramikorere rushobora
kugaragaza igihe cyose umutungo ufatika
udakwiye cyangwa amategeko atemerera
gusimbuzwa tokeni hashingiwe ku
nyungu rusange cyangwa ku bibazo
bishobora kubaho mu rwego
rw’amategeko.

articles.heading: Guhamagarira bwa mbere rubanda kugura umutungo koranabuhanga (1) Ikigo gifite ubuzimagatozi cyifuza
articles.text:
guhamagarira bwa mbere rubanda kugura
umutungo koranabuhanga mu Rwanda
cyangwa gishaka ko uwo mutungo
koranabuhanga wemererwa kwandikwa ku
isoko ku rubuga rw’ubucuruzi rukoreshwa
n’utanga serivisi z’umutungo
koranabuhanga mu Rwanda, gisaba
uburenganzira Urwego Ngenzuramikorere.
(2) Ushyira ku isoko ahamagarira bwa mbere
rubanda kugura umutungo koranabuhanga
atanga inyandiko irimo amakuru y’ingenzi
yerekeye igurishwa ry’uwo mutungo
koranabuhanga. Iyo nyandiko iba irimo
amakuru yose afasha umushoramari gufata
icyemezo gishingiye ku makuru afatika,
harimo –
(a) ibisobanuro ku biranga umutungo
koranabuhanga, imiterere n’imikorere
byawo bigomba kuba byubahirije
ibipimo ngenderwaho muri urwo rwego;
(b) umushoramari ugamijwe, yaba ari
usanzwe, ufite ubumenyi buhagije mu
bijyanye n’ishoramari, ikigo cyangwa
ufite umutungo uhagije;
(c) uburenganzira bw’umushoramari
n’inshingano zijyanye n’uwo mutungo
koranabuhanga;
(d) imiterere n’imikorere
by’ikoranabuhanga rikoreshwa ku
mutungo koranabuhanga, amahame
n’amabwiriza ajyanye na wo;
(e) amakuru asobanutse ku ngorane zifatika
zijyanye no gushora imari muri uwo
mutungo koranabuhanga washyizwe ku
isoko, harimo ingorane zijyanye
n’ihindagurika ry’agaciro, kwizerwa
kw’ikoranabuhanga rikoreshwa ku
mutungo koranabuhanga n’umutekano
w’urusobe koranabuhanga;
(f) ko ushyira ku isoko yubahiriza
amategeko n’amabwiriza agenga
imisoro;
(g) n’uko ushyira ku isoko umutungo
koranabuhanga n’ukoresha imbuga
zigurishirizwaho umutungo
koranabuhanga baha raporo Urwego
Ngenzuramikorere mu buryo
ngarukagihe.
(3) Amabwiriza ashobora kugena ibindi
bisabwa kugira ngo hemezwe ko rubanda
ruhamagarirwa bwa mbere kugura
umutungo koranabuhanga ku isoko.

articles.heading: Gushyira ku isoko amafaranga koranabuhanga adahindagurika (1) Ikigo gifite ubuzimagatozi cyifuza gushyira
articles.text:
ku isoko amafaranga koranabuhanga
adahindagurika mu Rwanda cyangwa
gishaka kwemererwa cyangwa kwandika
ku isoko ayo mafaranga koranabuhanga
adahindagurika agurishwa ku rubuga
rukoreshwa n’utanga serivisi z’umutungo
koranabuhanga ufite uruhushya mu
Rwanda kibanza kubyemererwa n’Urwego
Ngenzuramikorere.
(2) Ushyira ku isoko amafaranga
koranabuhanga adahindagurika ashyiraho
umugenagaciro w’umutungo wemewe
wujuje ibisabwa, kugira ngo agaragaze
umutungo uzigamira amafaranga
koranabuhanga adahindagurika n’uburyo
ayo mafaranga koranabuhanga
adahindagurika afitanye isano n’uwo
mutungo.
(3) Igenagaciro rigaragaza ko amafaranga
koranabuhanga adahindagurika yishingiwe
ku gipimo cya 100%, kugira ngo hizerwe
ko hahoraho umutungo uzigamwe ufite
ingwate igihe cyose utandukanyijwe n’indi
mitungo kandi utagomba kugurizwa abandi
hagamijwe inyungu y’inyongera.
(4) Umugenzuzi wigenga yemeza ko
umutungo uzigamwe uhagije ku buryo
ushobora kwishyura, mu buryo bukwiye
kandi ku gihe, abasaba kwishyurwa bose
bafite amafaranga koranabuhanga
adahindagurika atarishyurwa.
(5) Ushyira ku isoko amafaranga
koranabuhanga adahindagurika atanga
uburyo bwo kugenzura umutungo
uzigamwe.
(6) Umutungo uzigamwe urindwa n’umubitsi
w’umutungo w’umunyamwuga ufite
uruhushya kandi ugenzurwa ku buryo
buhoraho.
(7) Umutungo uzigamwe utandukanywa
n’undi mutungo w’ushyira ku isoko
amafaranga koranabuhanga
adahindagurika cyangwa uw’abandi
bamugurije, hagamijwe kurinda abafite
amafaranga koranabuhanga
adahindagurika mu gihe ushyira ku isoko
adashobora kwishyura imyenda cyangwa
yahombye.
(8) Amabwiriza ashobora kugena ibindi
bisabwa mu gushyira ku isoko no gucuruza
amafaranga koranabuhanga
adahindagurika. Ashobora kandi
kugaragaza uburyo imitungo izigamwe
ishobora gushorwa.
UMUTWE WA VI: IBIKORWA
BY’UBUCURUZI N’IMIKORERE
BY’ABATANGA SERIVISI
Z’UMUTUNGO KORANABUHANGA

articles.heading: Inshingano yo gutanga raporo (1) Utanga serivisi z’umutungo koranabuhanga aha Urwego
articles.text:
Ngenzuramikorere raporo kuri serivisi
z’umutungo koranabuhanga atanga, mu
miterere, mu gihe no mu buryo bigenwa
n’amabwiriza.

articles.heading: Ibikorwa bimenyekanishwa (1) Utanga serivisi z’umutungo koranabuhanga ukeka cyangwa ufite impamvu zituma akeka ko hari kimwe
articles.text:
muri ibi bikurikira cyabaye cyangwa
gishobora kuba, ahita abimenyesha mu
nyandiko Urwego Ngenzuramikorere iyo:
(a) atangiye kunanirwa kwishyura
imyenda;
(b) hari igitero cy’ikoranabuhanga,
harimo n’ibikorwa byageragejwe
bishobora kugira ingaruka ku bikorwa
no ku mukiriya;
(c) afite uruhare mu rubanza nshinjabyaha,
haba mu Rwanda cyangwa hanze
yarwo;
(d) yafunguye cyangwa yahagaritse
ibikorwa by’ubucuruzi bw’umutungo
koranabuhanga hanze y’u Rwanda;
(e) cyangwa hari ikindi gikorwa gishobora
kubangamira urwego rw’imari,
kugabanya ubushobozi bwarwo
cyangwa kugira ingaruka ku
kutajegajega n’ubwangamugayo
by’urwego rw’imari.
(2) Iyo utanga serivisi z’umutungo
koranabuhanga akeka cyangwa afite
impamvu zituma akeka ko amafaranga ari
indonke ikomoka ku cyaha cyangwa
afitanye isano no gutera inkunga
iterabwoba cyangwa gutera inkunga
ikwirakwiza ry’intwaro za kirimbuzi ahita
abimenyesha urwego rubifitiye ububasha.

articles.heading: Imyitwarire ya kinyamwuga y’utanga serivisi z’umutungo koranabuhanga (1) Utanga serivisi z’umutungo
articles.text:
koranabuhanga, mu gihe atanga serivisi
z’umutungo koranabuhanga –
(a) arangwa n’ubwangamugayo no
kutabogama;
(b) akorana ubushishozi, ubuhanga
n’ubwitange bikenewe;
(c) akorana ubunyamwuga bwo ku rwego
rwo hejuru;
koranabuhanga agomba kuba afite
imitungo ihagije ibarwa mu mafaranga,
harimo amafaranga afatika n’umutungo
ushobora kubyazwa amafaranga ku buryo
bworoshye kandi ashyira mu bikorwa
ingamba zinoze zo gucunga ingorane
zijyanye no kubura amafaranga.
(3) Amabwiriza agena igipimo
cy’amafaranga utanga serivisi
z’umutungo koranabuhanga agomba
kugira n’ibindi asabwa bijyanye
n’amafaranga agomba kuba afite.

articles.heading: Amafaranga n’indi mitungo ibarwa mu mafaranga bisabwa
Ihererekanya ry’umutungo koranabuhanga (1) Iyo hakozwe ihererekanya ry’umutungo koranabuhanga ufite agaciro kagenwa
articles.text:
n’urwego rubifitiye ububasha –
(a) utanga serivisi z’umutungo
koranabuhanga wohereje umutungo
koranabuhanga –
(i) agira kandi akabika amakuru
y’ukuri asabwa ku wohereza
n’amakuru asabwa ku
mugenerwabikorwa mu
ihererekanya ry’umutungo
koranabuhanga;
(ii) kandi ahita aha ayo makuru, mu
buryo butekanye, utanga serivisi
z’umutungo koranabuhanga
wakira cyangwa ikindi kigo
cy’imari kandi akayageza no ku
Rwego Ngenzuramikorere
cyangwa izindi nzego zibifitiye
ububasha iyo ziyamusabye;
(b) utanga serivisi z’umutungo
koranabuhanga wakira agira kandi
akabika amakuru y’uwohereza asabwa
n’amakuru nyayo
y’umugenerwabikorwa ku mutungo
koranabuhanga uhererekanywa
akayaha urwego rubifitiye ububasha
iyo ruyasabye.
(2)Utanga serivisi z’umutungo
koranabuhanga ashyiraho umubare
ntarengwa ku gikorwa cy’ubucuruzi cya
buri mutungo koranabuhanga hashingiwe
ku bishingirwaho mu igenzura
ry’ingorane.
(3)Utanga serivisi z’umutungo
koranabuhanga ashyiraho mu bushishozi
umubare ntarengwa ujyanye n’ingorane
zijyanye n’imyitwarire y’umukiriya
n’imiterere y’ubucuruzi.

articles.heading: Kurengera no guhugura umushoramari n’umuguzi (1) Mu rwego rwo kurengera umuguzi cyangwa umushoramari, utanga serivisi
articles.text:
z’umutungo koranabuhanga –
(a) amugira inama ikwiye ishobora
kumutera kugura, gushora, kurushaho
gukoresha cyangwa gukomeza
gukoresha igicuruzwa runaka;
(b) amumenyesha mu buryo burambuye
igiciro cy’igicuruzwa;
(c) ashyiraho uburyo bwizewe bwo
kumurinda uburiganya;
(d) kandi akora ku buryo ahabwa amakuru
y’ukuri.
(2) Utanga serivisi z’umutungo
koranabuhanga ntiyemerewe gutanga
cyangwa gutangaza mu buryo buziguye
cyangwa butaziguye, amakuru ashobora
kugera ku mukiriya arebana no
kumenyekanisha umutungo
koranabuhanga, keretse iyo ayo makuru
agaragaza ingorane akanaburira kuri izo
ngorane bikaba bisaba ko ashyirwa ahantu
hagaragara neza.

articles.heading: Imyitwarire ku isoko n’imikorere itabogamye (1) Utanga serivisi z’umutungo koranabuhanga akora ku buryo imbuga ze
articles.text:
zimenyekanisha ubucuruzi butabogamye
kandi bukorera mu mucyo.
(2) Utanga serivisi z’umutungo
koranabuhanga yita ku nyungu z’abakiriya
kandi akabafata mu buryo bungana.
Ubutumwa bwose bugenewe umukiriya
bugomba kuba bukwiye kandi buteye ku
buryo ashobora kubusobanukirwa. Ibibazo
n’ingorane by’umukiriya bigomba
gukemurwa ku gihe no mu buryo
buhoraho.
(3) Utanga serivisi z’umutungo
koranabuhanga akora ku buryo imikorere
n’imigenzurire bye biba bikwiranye
n’urugero n’imiterere by’imirimo ijyanye
na serivisi z’umutungo koranabuhanga
kandi bigatuma hatunganywa ku buryo
y’umukiriya binyuze mu kuyabika neza,
kuyabungabunga, kubika neza inyandiko
akubiyemo, akanubahiriza ibindi
biteganywa n’amategeko abigenga.
(2) Utanga serivisi z’umutungo
koranabuhanga ashyira mu bikorwa kandi
mu buryo buhoraho –
(a) ingamba zo gukusanya neza amakuru
n’inyandiko bijyanye n’uwohereza
n’umugenerwabikorwa;
(b) n’ingamba zo kurinda amakuru bwite
y’umukiriya zubahiriza itegeko
ryerekeye kurinda amakuru bwite
n’imibereho bwite by’umuntu n’ibindi
bisabwa bya ngombwa.
(3) Utanga serivisi z’umutungo
koranabuhanga akoresha kandi
akabungabunga ibikoresho byo
gukurikirana ibikorwa by’ubucuruzi
hagamijwe gusuzuma ibikorwa
by’ubucuruzi byinjiza n’ibisohora
umutungo koranabuhanga no gusuzuma
aderesi yifashishwa mu kohereza no
kwakira umutungo koranabuhanga.

articles.heading: Kurinda amakuru bwite y’umukiriya n’imitungo ye
Umutekano w’ikoranabuhanga n’uw’amakuru (1) Utanga serivisi z’umutungo koranabuhanga ashyiraho uburyo
articles.text:
bw’imikorere, ubwo kugenzura na politiki
bikwiye hagamijwe –
(a) guhangana n’ingorane, zirimo
izerekeye umutekano w’ibijyanye
n’ikoranabuhanga mu
itangazabumenyi n’itumanaho
zishobora kubangamira ubucuruzi
n’ibikorwa bijyanye n’umutungo
koranabuhanga no kurinda umutekano
w’umutungo koranabuhanga
n’uw’amakuru by’umukiriya;
(b) kugira sisitemu z’ikoranabuhanga
zishoboye guhangana n’ibibazo kandi
zifite ubushobozi buhagije ku buryo
butanga icyizere cyo gukora ibikorwa
by’ubucuruzi byagutse;
(c) no kugena uburyo bwo gukomeza
gukora ubucuruzi igihe haba habaye
ikibazo, harimo uburyo bwo kugira
ahandi habikwa amakuru n’ubwo
kongera gushobora gukora nyuma
y’ikibazo gikomeye cyaba kibaye,
ibikorwaremezo n’ahantu bifasha
gukomeza gukora kwa serivisi no
gutanga raporo mu gihe habayeho
ikibazo cyose muri sisitemu
z’ikoranabuhanga.
(2) Utanga serivisi z’umutungo
koranabuhanga akora ku buryo uburyo
bwe bwo gucunga ibyateza ingorane mu
rwego rw’ikoranabuhanga butanga
igisubizo ku ngorane zavuka zijyanye no
gukora kode zifasha kugera ku mutungo
cyangwa kuri konti zibikwaho umutungo
koranabuhanga, gusinya no kwemeza
ibikorwa by’ubucuruzi, kubika kode
zifasha kugera ku mutungo koranabuhanga
n’uruhererekane rw’amagambo rufasha
kongera kwinjira muri konti no gufungura
konti zibikwaho umutungo koranabuhanga
no kuzicunga.
(3) Utanga serivisi z’umutungo
koranabuhanga ashyiraho kandi
agakurikiza buri gihe uburyo bw’imikorere
buhamye, harimo gushyiraho ingamba
zihamye z’umutekano w’ibijyanye
n’ikoranabuhanga mu itangazabumenyi
n’itumanaho, ibipimo ngenderwaho mu
gukora raporo z’imari no gukora
ubugenzuzi bw’imbere kugira ngo serivisi
ze zibe zizewe kandi zitekanye.
(4) Utanga serivisi z’umutungo
koranabuhanga akora ku buryo imirimo
y’urubuga n’ibindi bikorwa bye
bidahagarara, binyuze mu –
(a) kugira ibindi bikorwaremezo bikwiye
byakwifashishwa igihe ibisanzwe
bikoreshwa bigize ikibazo;
(b) gushyiraho no gushyira mu bikorwa
uburyo na gahunda byo kongera
kubona amakuru no gukomeza gukora
igihe havutse ikibazo;
(c) gukora igerageza ngarukagihe ry’ireme
ry’ibikorwaremezo byakwifashishwa
igihe ibisanzwe bikoreshwa byaba
bigize ikibazo n’irya gahunda yo
gukomeza ibikorwa igihe haba havutse
ikibazo;
(d) no gukora ku buryo sisitemu
y’ikoranabuhanga mu itumanaho iba
yujuje ibisabwa bijyanye no kubona
amakuru, kuyarinda no kubungabunga
umwimerere wayo kandi akaba afite
ireme.
(5) Umutekano w’ikoranabuhanga n’amakuru
by’utanga serivisi z’umutungo
koranabuhanga bigomba kugenzurwa no
gusuzumwa mu buryo ngarukagihe
n’umugenzuzi wigenga w’umwuga mu
bijyanye n’umutekano w’ikoranabuhanga
n’amakuru.
UMUTWE WA VII: UBUGENZUZI
N’ISHYIRWA MU BIKORWA

articles.heading: Igenzura (1) Urwego Ngenzuramikorere rukora igenzura rugamije kureba ko ibiteganywa n’iri tegeko byubahirizwa
articles.text:
(2) Urwego Ngenzuramikorere rugenzura
utanga serivisi z’umutungo
koranabuhanga igihe cyose, rwaba
rwamumenyesheje cyangwa
rutamumenyesheje.
(3) Urwego Ngenzuramikorere rushyiraho
abagenzuzi cyangwa inzobere kandi
rukabaha ububasha bwo gukora igenzura.
(4) Utanga serivisi z’umutungo
koranabuhanga akorana n’Urwego
Ngenzuramikorere kandi agaha
umugenzuzi, cyangwa inzobere
rwashyizeho amakuru akeneye.

articles.heading: Guhagarika umutungo koranabuhanga (1) Urwego rubifitiye ububasha rushobora gutegeka ihagarikwa ry’umutungo
articles.text:
koranabuhanga igihe ruketse ko
wakoreshejwe mu bikorwa binyuranyije
n’amategeko, birimo iyezandonke, gutera
inkunga iterabwoba, gutera inkunga
ikwirakwiza ry’intwaro za kirimbuzi,
uburiganya cyangwa ibindi byaha byo mu
rwego rw’imari.
(2) Urwego rubifitiye ububasha rushobora
gufata icyemezo cyo guhagarika umutungo
koranabuhanga hashingiwe ku bimenyetso
bifatika cyangwa ku iperereza ryakozwe
ku bikorwa bikekwa ko binyuranyije
n’amategeko.
(3) Urwego rubifitiye ububasha rushobora
guhagarika umutungo koranabuhanga mu
rwego rw’iperereza ku byaha cyangwa
hagamijwe kubahiriza ibihano
n’amabwiriza mpuzamahanga, harimo
imyanzuro y’Akanama k’Umuryango
w’Abibumbye Gashinzwe Amahoro ku Isi
cyangwa intonde z’ibihano zemewe.
(4) Utanga serivisi z’umutungo
koranabuhanga cyangwa ushyira ku isoko
ahagarika umutungo koranabuhanga kandi
yubahiriza ibibujijwe birimo kudakorana
ibikorwa by’ubucuruzi n’abantu n’inzego
byashyizwe ku rutonde mu rwego rwo
kurwanya iyezandonke, gutera inkunga
iterabwoba no gutera inkunga ikwirakwiza
ry’intwaro za kirimbuzi.

articles.heading: Gusonerwa uburyozwe Urwego Ngenzuramikorere, abagize Inama y’Ubutegetsi yarwo, abayobozi bakuru
articles.text:
n’abakozi barwo ntibaryozwa ibikorwa
bakoze cyangwa batakoze mu gihe buzuza
inshingano z’Urwego Ngenzuramikorere
ziteganywa n’iri tegeko nta buriganya.

N’IBIHANO

articles.text: Icyiciro cya 2 : Ibyaha n’ibihano

articles.heading: Ubucuruzi bw’umutungo koranabuhanga bukozwe n’umuntu ku giti cye Umuntu ku giti cye ukora ubucuruzi
articles.text:
bw’umutungo koranabuhanga aba akoze
icyaha. Iyo abihamijwe n’urukiko, ahanishwa
ihazabu itari munsi ya FRW 30.000.000 ariko
itarenze FRW 50.000.000 n’igihano
cy’igifungo kitari munsi y’imyaka 3 ariko
kitarenze imyaka 5 cyangwa kimwe muri ibyo
bihano.

articles.heading: Gutanga serivisi z’umutungo koranabuhanga nta ruhushya Ikigo gifite ubuzimagatozi gikora ibijyanye na
articles.text:
serivisi z’umutungo koranabuhanga nta
ruhushya kiba gikoze icyaha. Iyo kibihamijwe
n’urukiko, gihanishwa ihazabu itari munsi ya
FRW 70.000.000 ariko itarenze
FRW 100.000.000.

articles.heading: Gushyira ku isoko umutungo koranabuhanga utabyemerewe Ikigo gifite ubuzimagatozi gishyira ku isoko
articles.text:
umutungo koranabuhanga kitabyemerewe kiba
gikoze icyaha. Iyo kibihamijwe n’urukiko,
gihanishwa ihazabu itari munsi ya
FRW 120.000.000 ariko itarenze
FRW 150.000.000.

articles.heading: Kumenyekanisha nta ruhushya cyangwa utabyemerewe Ikigo gifite ubuzimagatozi gikora ibikorwa
articles.text:
byo kumenyekanisha ibijyanye n’umutungo
koranabuhanga kitabifitiye uruhushya
cyangwa kitabyemerewe, kiba gikoze icyaha.
Iyo kibihamijwe n’urukiko gihanishwa
ihazabu itari munsi ya FRW 15.000.000 ariko
itarenze FRW 20.000.000.

articles.heading: Gutanga amakuru atari ukuri cyangwa ayobya cyangwa kubangamira ibikorwa by’igenzura Umuntu uri mu Nama y’Ubutegetsi cyangwa
articles.text:
mu Buyobozi Bukuru by’ushyira ku isoko
cyangwa by’utanga serivisi z’umutungo
koranabuhanga –
(a) utanga amakuru atari ukuri cyangwa
ayobya cyangwa wanga guha amakuru
Urwego Ngenzuramikorere;
(b) cyangwa ubangamira mu buryo ubwo
ari bwo bwose imirimo y’igenzura
y’Urwego Ngenzuramikorere,
imicungire yarwo cyangwa ifatwa
ry’ibyemezo byarwo bireba ushyira ku
isoko cyangwa utanga serivisi
z’umutungo koranabuhanga wemejwe
ko yahombye mu Rwanda cyangwa mu
mahanga;
aba akoze icyaha. Iyo abihamijwe n’urukiko,
ahanishwa ihazabu itari munsi ya FRW
3.000.000 ariko itarenze FRW 5.000.000
n’igihano cy’igifungo kitari munsi y’amezi 6
ariko kitarenze umwaka 1 cyangwa kimwe
muri ibyo bihano.

articles.heading: Kwishyurana, gushyiraho ibikorwaremezo cyangwa gukoresha serivisi zo kuvanga umutungo koranabuhanga utabiherewe
articles.text:
uburenganzira
(1) Umuntu ku giti cye:
(a) ukoresha imitungo
koranabuhanga mu kwishyurana
mu Rwanda, adafite
uburenganzira bwa Banki Nkuru;
(b) ushyiraho ibikorwaremezo
byifashishwa mu guhanga
umutungo koranabuhanga
atabiherewe uburenganzira;
(c) ushyiraho imashini itanga
amafaranga koranabuhanga
cyangwa umutungo
koranabuhanga atabiherewe
uburenganzira ;
(d) cyangwa ushyiraho uburyo
cyangwa serivisi yo kuvanga
umutungo koranabuhanga
bigamije kutagaragaza ba
nyir’umutungo atabiherewe
uburenganzira;
aba akoze icyaha. Iyo abihamijwe
n’urukiko, ahanishwa ihazabu itari
munsi ya FRW 20.000.000 ariko
itarenze FRW 30.000.000 n’igifungo
cy’imyaka itari munsi ya 2 ariko
itarenze 3 cyangwa kimwe muri ibyo
bihano.
(2) Iyo icyaha kivugwa mu gika cya (1)
gikozwe n’ikigo gifite ubuzimagatozi,
igihano kiba ihazabu itari munsi ya
FRW 70.000.000 ariko itarenze
FRW 100.000.000.
